preconditions.description: T is a positive integer not exceeding 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and N >= 1 and N <= 10**9 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each N is a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(max_value(N)) for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]]]
postconditions.description: For each N, the output is the maximum possible value of the permutation of integers from 1 to N, where the value is defined as the sum of (i XOR P_i) for i from 1 to N.
